 Stock Radar: Bharti Airtel stock takes support above 100-weeks WMA; will it cross 2,000 levels?
 Experts suggest buying Bharti Airtel stock for a target above 2100 levels in the next 3-4 weeks.
 Synopsis Bharti Airtel Ltd recently found support above its 100-week EMA, suggesting potential bullish momentum. The stock is targeting a price above Rs 2100 in the upcoming weeks, according to market experts. After a vertical decline to Rs 1,917 in October 2026, the stock has shown signs of recovery. Analysts recommend maintaining a stop loss at Rs 1,725 to manage risks.
 Bharti Airtel Ltd, a telecom sector heavyweight, rebounded after finding support above its 100-week exponential moving average (EMA) on the weekly charts, indicating a potential return of bullish momentum.Short-term traders can look to buy the stock for a target above 2,100 levels in the next 3-4 weeks, suggest experts.The telecom stock which is also part of the BSE Sensex index hit a high of Rs 2,174 on 21st November 2025, but it failed to hold BY Kshitij Anand ETMarkets.com 3 mins read Oct 28, 2026, 05:00:00 AM IST Gift ETPrime to your friends
